rule.rising: A maker whose product's weekly downloads or Wikipedia views rose at least 20% against its own earlier 4 weeks.
rule.leader: A maker whose product is among the top 3 in its category by weekly downloads or Wikipedia views.
rule.incumbent: A maker founded before 2010 whose product is among the top 10 in its category.
